title: Adaptive Hashing
tagline: Compare probe strategies under growing load while tracking expected insertion cost.

curves.label: Linear Probing
curves.code: for (i=0;i<n;i++){ let k=i%cap; for (p=0;p<cap;p++){ if (T[(k+p)%cap].empty){ T[(k+p)%cap]=i; break;} } }
curves.name: Linear Probing

curves.label: Quadratic Probing
curves.code: for (i=0;i<n;i++){ let k=i%cap; for (p=0;p<cap;p++){ let idx=(k+p*p)%cap; if (T[idx].empty){ T[idx]=i; break; } } }
curves.name: Quadratic Probing

curves.label: Double Hashing
curves.code: for (i=0;i<n;i++){ let k1=i%cap; let step=(7 - (i%7))%cap; for (p=0;p<cap;p++){ let idx=(k1+p*step)%cap; if (T[idx].empty){ T[idx]=i; break; } } }
curves.name: Double Hashing

curves.label: Robin Hood Hashing
curves.code: for (i=0;i<n;i++){ let key=i; let idx=key%cap; let dist=0; while(true){ if(T[idx].empty){T[idx]=key; break;} let curDist=(idx-(T[idx]%cap)+cap)%cap; if(curDist<dist){ let tmp=T[idx]; T[idx]=key; key=tmp; dist=curDist; } idx=(idx+1)%cap; dist++; } }
curves.name: Robin Hood Hashing

curves.label: Cuckoo Hashing (Kicks)
curves.code: for (i=0;i<n;i++){ let key=i; let pos1=key%cap; let pos2=(key*2654435761)%cap; let pos=pos1; for (t=0;t<cap;t++){ if(T[pos].empty){T[pos]=key; break;} let evict=T[pos]; T[pos]=key; key=evict; pos=(pos==pos1)?pos2:((key%cap)); } }
curves.name: Cuckoo Hashing (Kicks)
